art.title: The Goldfinch
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons (Mauritshuis)
art.story: A little goldfinch sits on the perch of its feeder against a pale plaster wall, tied by a fine chain to its leg, with a tiny cup beside it. Goldfinches were popular pets, and some were taught to draw up their own water in a little bucket. Carel Fabritius, once a pupil of Rembrandt, painted it life-size with a few quick strokes, and the light casts a soft shadow on the wall. The same year, a gunpowder store blew up in Delft and he was killed, aged 32. Only about a dozen of his paintings survive.
